question: Does the detector reproduce the GT21 signs across treadmill, overground, ramps and stairs without a wrong sign, and does it leave the non-sagittal model pelvis unchecked?
selection: numpy default_rng(seed): permutation over local subjects with all four modes and a GT21-S01 Weight literal, first N; then per subject and mode a permutation of recordings, read in order until every class has 10 strides with plate-captured stance per leg or the mode cap {'treadmill': 1, 'levelground': 8, 'ramp': 12, 'stair': 12} is reached

builder_history.note: Probe and sheet steps are separate files from the start. Before the recorded run: a one-subject pilot of the same code (written outside the repository) found the stance-capture rule too strict (the stride ends at the next heel strike, and on stairs plate contact starts before the source heel strike), and the first full run stopped at the 280 MiB cap because importing the detector through the package loaded pandas; both fixed, the one-subject pilot re-run (peak 195 MiB, no wrong sign), then a full run (peak 221 MiB). That run showed the leg gate counting strides with withheld force as "knee peak in swing"; the detector gate was fixed (units without stance information do not vote; synthetic test) and the full run repeated with the same probe file and seed. Repeat vs first full run: identical verdicts in all 648 leg-channels; gate pass -> unknown in 5 legs (AB09 up L, AB18 lvl L, AB18 up L, AB24 up L, AB24 st-up R). The first full run is not kept in the repository.

Sheet step only, no data read: the rejected-recording chip now states the verified cause (plate file starts 1 ms after the kinematics; dropping one sample would recover it) and figure 3 bars are neutral instead of the wrong-sign red. Counts, verdicts and the probe file are unchanged.

ground_truth.source: docs/quality/audits/gt21-c01-conventions.json (model rotation axes, knee range -120..10 deg, joint_moments positive along the coordinate) mapped to rule B
ground_truth.pelvis: not tested: model heading sagittal in 1 of 131 recordings

adapter.channels: ik (deg -> rad, model zero), id (N*m, not mass-normalized), jp (W)
adapter.units: source heel strike to heel strike per leg (gcRight/gcLeft), 0.6-2.5 s, resampled to 150
adapter.geometry: none: plate CoP and markers are both in the OpenSim lab frame (GT21-C01); no shift applied; tested by the detector CoP-within-foot check

rejected_recordings.rejected: ValueError: ramp_6_l_01_02.mat: fp clock does not contain the 200 Hz samples

explanations.pelvis: Model heading about +-90 deg (subjects walk along lab Z; GT21-C01), so ik pelvis_tilt is mostly obliquity and the pelvis was not tested. One recording had a circular-median heading inside the band with a wide spread (a turning path); its strides were a minority of the leg, so the pelvis stayed unchecked there as well.
explanations.knee_power: Knee power has no timing test; the power identity needs the knee angle and knee moment applied, and the knee moment has only the knee lever arm (one family), so the identity has no anchor.
explanations.knee_moment: Only the knee lever arm (plate geometry) tests the knee moment: suggest at most.
explanations.hip_and_ankle_power: Power timing covers level walking (hip H3) and level/incline walking (ankle); elsewhere only the power identity can vote, which is one family.
explanations.stairs: Stair descent is outside the plate-timed tests and the leg gate; stair angles then rest on markers alone (one family). The knee range test needs walking.

half_cycle.ambiguous: Where the half-cycle check is ambiguous, the marker and plate-timing tests merge into one "fixed timing shape" family (suggest at most).
half_cycle.half: All "half" results are the hip lever arm (a weak test): its per-stride correlation with the source hip moment is low (median |r| 0.13-0.63) and slightly higher at a half-cycle lag, so it abstained, as designed. Likely causes: the hip point is a thigh marker, not the joint centre, and the lever arm ignores the swing-phase inertial moment. No wrong sign followed; the hip moment was still applied from the other families in 8 of those 10 legs.

explanations.leg_gate_not_decided: Stair descent is outside the gate (12 legs). On ramps and stair ascent the knee peak fell in swing in 74-89 % of strides, below the 90 % needed to pass (large early-stance knee flexion); nothing failed. One overground leg had too few strides with captured stance.
explanations.plate_frame_unknown: CoP progression and braking/propulsion are defined for forward heel-strike walking, so they are unknown on stairs (24 legs each); the remaining unknowns had too few or mixed votes.

rejected_recordings.rejected: ValueError: ramp_6_l_01_02.mat: fp clock does not contain the 200 Hz samples
rejected_recordings.explanation: ik runs at 200 Hz from 53.935 s; fp runs at 1000 Hz on the exact ms grid but starts at 53.936 s, so only the first kinematic sample (1 of 3975) has no plate sample. Dropping that one sample would recover the recording; the probe rejected the whole recording (conservative).
rejected_recordings.explanation_source: CORE-04 verifier, GT21 pilot check 6 (bounded read of the ik and fp Header columns)

resources.mode: read-only probe exception; one recording at a time; nice 19, ionice idle, 1 thread; RLIMIT_AS 1.5 GiB

limitations: 6 subjects, 72 legs; seeded recordings per mode, not every recording.
Task per stride is geometric (pelvis rise over run), not the source label; transition strides excluded.
Hip point is the Thigh_Upper marker (no trochanter marker); the vertical-order guard decides its use.
Model heading about 90 deg: pelvis tilt not tested.
Body mass unit unresolved (GT21-S01); used only by the GRF-unit check and ID-light; signs only.
No detector threshold was changed for this pilot; the GRF-unit check now ignores units whose GRF the adapter withheld (bug found by this pilot, synthetic test added).
